subject: IT352
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 2 Arabic videos. The English selection is strong, with high-quality, relevant content from authoritative sources like Stanford, NNgroup, and ACM SIGCHI for all topics. Arabic coverage is weak, with no suitable videos found for 3 of the 5 topics (Experimental Design, Quantitative Measures, Field Studies) due to a lack of relevant candidates in the search results. For the remaining two topics, one selection was made using the low-view exception rule, and another explains one half of a comparative topic.
